title: Settings of the AWS HTTP adapter
description: The settings of the adapter that sends log.* events to the add_log endpoint of aws_microservice (T-04.6, ADR-008). The endpoint is host + ":" + port + path. The adapter always POSTs, never compresses and never follows a redirect, and it reuses the shared client (http_client.schema.json) for the rest. The library reads no file and no environment (ADR-004); no value of a real project is held here. The order of the properties is the order in which a validation reports its problems.

host.description: The host WITH its scheme, for example http://localhost (as in the old adapter, ADR-008). Required, http or https.

path.description: The path of the add_log endpoint, starting with /. Required.

log_group_name.description: The CloudWatch log group the entries go to (a placeholder such as my-log-group in this repository). Required.

log_stream_name.description: The CloudWatch log stream the entries go to. Required.

timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds before a request gives up (default 3000).

skip_tls_verification.description: Turn the verification of the TLS certificate OFF. On by default (REQ-SEC-005).

bearer_token.description: A bearer token for the Authorization header. A secret, no default, never in an error or a result (REQ-SEC-007). Not together with an API key.

api_key_header.description: The name of the header that carries an API key. Needs api_key_value.

api_key_value.description: The API key. A secret, no default. Needs api_key_header.

max_attempts.description: Attempts at most for one request, the first included (default 5).

retry_base_delay_ms.description: The base of the exponential backoff in milliseconds (default 200).

retry_max_delay_ms.description: The ceiling of the backoff in milliseconds (default 30000). Not below the base.
